title: Sargent Images from NGV
content: The National Gallery of Victoria in Melbourne has in its collection nine examples ofpaintings and drawings by John Singer Sargent.Hospital at Granada (1912)John Singer SARGENToil on canvas 56.2 × 71.5 cmOne of them shows patients recovering at a hospital in Spain. The scene appears to be painted completely on location, with the artist focusing on each person or grouping in turn.At theNGV website, you can zoomwayinto the paintings and see the economy of strokes that Sargent used to describe the forms.The website also has64 works by Arthur Streeton, 34 works byCharles Conder, and 77 works byNorman Lindsay, with similar zoomable features.----NGV Online Collection:John Singer Sargents at the National Gallery of VictoriaThanks,Sascha Karschner
